newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Feb wholesale prices up 1.8 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Thai Feb wholesale prices up 1.8 pct yr/yr.

text.p: The Thai wholesale price index (WPI) rose 1.8 percent year-on-year in February against a 3.0 percent increase in the previous month, the Commerce Ministry said on Monday.
The ministry said wholesale prices fell 0.5 percent in February from January against a 0.1 percent month-on-month increase in the previous month.
The ministry said the 1985-based index rose to 155.2 in February from its 152.4 level in February 1996.
